subject: design/feature-draft
statement: Source discovery omits every plan-directory document whose feature has no PRD ledger at the pinned commit.
intent: Keep draft-born plans outside memory while preserving document-pipeline plan capture.
rationale: The ledger must be identified from the complete pinned tree before source selection; path-only classification cannot distinguish a draft-born plan from a document-pipeline plan.
fit_criterion: A pinned Git snapshot excludes a no-ledger plan from files, authored sources, capture actions, and findings, while a ledger-backed plan still receives a capture action.
